result.topic_en: Spherical-astronomy calculation with a sketch of a spherical triangle (sides δ, 90°+c, angle a), transforming an expression in c, i, a with angles φ, δ and rewriting c/sin p + n cos p/sin p in half-angle form.
result.transcription:
[Figur: sphärisches Dreieck im Kreis, Seiten $\delta$, $90^0+c$, Winkel $a$, $\alpha$]
96
$\frac{c}{\cos\delta} + \quad i(\cos\varphi\cos\delta + \sin\varphi\sin\delta) + a\sin\varphi\cos\delta - \cos\varphi\sin\delta$
$\dot{o}\cos\varphi + a\sin\varphi$ [?]
$\frac{c}{\cos\delta} + i\cos\varphi + a\sin\varphi + (i\sin\varphi - a\cos\varphi)\,\mathrm{tg}\,\delta$
[-$c + i\,\omega$-] [?] $\quad \overline{\sin\delta}$
$\frac{c}{\sin p} + n\frac{\cos p}{\sin p}$
$(\cos\frac{p}{2})^2 - \sin(\frac{p}{2})^2$
$\cos(\frac{p}{2})^2 + \sin\frac{p}{2}^2$
$\frac{c+n}{2}\cot\frac{p}{2} + \frac{c-n}{2}\mathrm{tg}\,\frac{p}{2}$

methods.what: Expansion of an expression in c, i, a using the angle-difference formulas for cos(φ−δ) and sin(φ−δ), divided by cos δ to give a tan δ form
Half-angle identities cos p = cos²(p/2) − sin²(p/2) and 1 = cos²(p/2) + sin²(p/2) used to rewrite (c + n cos p)/sin p
Resulting identity c/sin p + n cot p = ((c+n)/2) cot(p/2) + ((c−n)/2) tan(p/2)
